Unsere Scantechnologie liefert detailgenaue, georeferenzierte digitale Zwillinge und setzt neue Maßstäbe in Präzision und Kosteneffizienz. Du begeisterst dich für KI, denkst dich gerne in neue Themen ein und möchtest aus Ideen funktionierende Anwendungen machen? Dann gestalte mit uns, wie wir bei HydroMapper Daten auswerten, Prozesse automatisieren und neue Technologien in die Praxis bringen. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in Hamburg ! Manuelle Prozesse automatisieren: Gemeinsam mit unseren Teams identifizierst du wiederkehrende oder aufwendige Arbeitsschritte und entwickelst Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern. Lösungen in die Anwendung bringen: Du begleitest deine Ideen von der Problemdefinition über Prototypen und die Bewert

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it

Bei uns fühlen sich Entwickelnde wohl, die gerne in einem starken, enthusiastischen Team auf Augenhöhe gemeinsam wachsen und Leidenschaft für Technik teilen. Claude Code, Codex) und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse selbst. Du entwickelst Modelle für Recommendations, Prognosen und Klassifizierungen. Du evaluierst Modelle mit klaren Metriken und Vergleichswerten. jobs.title: Robotics Data Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About EASE EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot. The role Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to build pipelines that turn raw exoskeleton recordings into clean, robot-ready training data, including retargeting human motion to the humanoid’s body. So in the future human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks. What you'll do Define signals, formats and metadata for our next exoskeleton generation Build pipelines from devices in the field to storage, incl. sync, calibration and versioning Build tooling for quality checks, segmentation, annotation and dataset export Implement anonymization, consent handling and GDPR-compliant data flows Set up storage and compute together with our robot learning team What you bring Degree in CS, data engineering, robotics or similar, with hands-on pipeline experience Strong Python and SQL; pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, Ray or Spark) Time-series or multimodal sensor data, incl. synchronization and calibration Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker and Linux Solid understanding of GDPR and personal data Nice to have ROS 2, MCAP or LeRobot; annotation or dataset management tools Kubernetes or SLURM; basic ML training workflows in PyTorch Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match. What we offer Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment The chance to build our data platform from the ground up Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP) Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit Budg
